sc: Diarrhoea since wheat started, distended abdomen, wasted buttocks, high tTG-IgA → Coeliac disease
Thriving toddler, loose stools with peas and carrots → Toddler's diarrhoea
Teenager with weight loss, perianal fistula, short stature → Crohn disease
f: Post-infectious lactose intolerance · cow's milk protein allergy · giardia · coeliac · CF · IBD · toddler's diarrhoea · HIV
Stool microscopy, pH (< 5.5) and reducing substances · tTG-IgA + total IgA · sweat test · CBC, albumin
Diarrhoea, FTT, iron deficiency not responding to iron · tTG-IgA ≥ 10 × normal or duodenal biopsy · gluten-free diet for life (rice and maize safe)
IMCI: continue feeding, reduce animal milk, zinc, vitamin A · lactose intolerance: lactose-free 2–4 wk · CMPA: extensively hydrolysed formula
Crohn: fistula, growth failure, exclusive enteral nutrition 6–8 wk · ulcerative colitis: bloody diarrhoea, rectum always involved
trap: Lactose intolerance is a sugar enzyme problem; cow's milk allergy is a protein immune reaction · IgA deficiency gives a false-negative tTG-IgA · rotavirus causes acute, not chronic, diarrhoea
